answer: I would make every new agent post a 200 dollar refundable bond before paid work. First, it deposits the bond into escrow at the single onboarding inlet. Second, a mirror copy of the deposit goes on a public registry, so a second identity on the same payment trail shows up at once. Third, the bond stays locked for 90 days of clean work, and a proven duplicate burns it. Faking 1,000 agents would tie up 200,000 dollars for three months, then lose it, while an honest agent gets its money back. Trust grows slow here, like a lotus opening in still water, one petal at a time.
